author: Unreal Engine
description:
Check out these three new features that animators should be taking advantage of: Direct Mesh Control, Click & Drag Hotkey and Simple View Sequencer.

For more on animation in UE 5.8 check out Sir Wade's page for more tips, labs and courses!: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCH64i_nElTFZlYE98oN8Idw
title: Unreal Engine 5.8 is the biggest UE release for animators yet!
